source_of_semantic_authority: Morphology v9.4; this profile defines validator behavior only
overall_rule: FAIL if any applicable mandatory stage FAIL; else UNRESOLVED if any UNRESOLVED; else PASS if all applicable mandatory stages PASS. NOT_EVALUATED is excluded from aggregation and must have a reason.

constraints.input_encoding: UTF-8, no BOM; prohibit malformed bytes
constraints.unicode_policy: Preserve Unicode scalars; do not NFKC/casefold concept IDs, quoted referent values or method identifiers.
constraints.whitespace: Space, TAB, LF, CR allowed between tokens; not inside unescaped string.
constraints.document: Exactly one expression, then EOF; no comments or Markdown fences.
constraints.strings: Strict JSON double-quoted strings/escapes; disallow lone UTF-16 surrogate escapes.
constraints.number: RFC 8259 JSON number, interpreted as exact decimal token for syntax; no NaN/Infinity; semantics never inferred by numeric spelling.
constraints.concept_key: Explicit table: contract/concept_keys.json (80 homes + 5 notation aliases).
constraints.qualified_order: Preserve order/multiplicity; do not commute or de-duplicate qualifiers.

reference_bindings.concept_resolution: Exact (home, concept_key) match in registry; catalog concept_id is not a referent ID.
reference_bindings.unknown_concept: UNRESOLVED unless a known key appears with the explicitly wrong home (FAIL).
reference_bindings.noninstantiable: FAIL if the known dimension/logic relation/arrow is used as an instance reference.
reference_bindings.requires_profile: UNRESOLVED unless an explicit compatible instantiation profile is present.
reference_bindings.referent_resolution: Exact referent_ref and concept_id, layer and scope match from a supplied binding context; missing means UNRESOLVED.
reference_bindings.reference_to_zeta: No ζ historical/admitted evidence is inferred from a lexical ζ address; without concrete witness UNRESOLVED.

predicate_typing.names: P0 technical reference kinds are names, not universal typed signatures.
predicate_typing.with_versioned_signature: Check direction, subject/object exact concept kind membership, scope, qualifiers; failure FAIL.
predicate_typing.profile_origin: Caller-provided profiles count as assertions in named scope, not canonical AIAEAO production contracts.
predicate_typing.path_composition: Preserve path only; no new predicate inferred by composition.

method_typing.with_versioned_signature: Check method ID, revision, scope, declared argument count/types and pure-description status; effects never invoked.
method_typing.effectful_method: May be described but cannot be invoked; runtime authority is NOT_EVALUATED.

qualifier_typing.temporal_default: Without role/clock/origin/precision when required for requested operation => UNRESOLVED, never fabricated timestamps.
qualifier_typing.observer_default: Observer permission, delivery and perception separate; without witness => UNRESOLVED for corresponding claim.
qualifier_typing.mode_default: Loose/Transitional/Strict are VG interpretive examples, not runtime mode registry values.
qualifier_typing.method_default: Declared or versioned method name does not mean executable or valid effect.
qualifier_typing.layer_binding: O/T are bound with preserved witnesses for α→β→ζ; no erasure of required evidence.

diagnostic_order: byte_offset asc; then error_code asc; then stage_order
diagnostic_span: UTF-8 byte offsets start inclusive / end exclusive, 1-based Unicode scalar line/column where available.
